text: Call the police. I'm not saying that doesn't mean to put safe boundaries around yourself. You should be wise when it comes to boundaries, and we should be people who allow the the system that God has placed in our country to do the work of justice when when it can. But it does mean that you are not carrying around with you the burden and the pressure that you have to watch over everything to be sure that that person pays. No, no, you release to God. Remember.
